Name: Spouses Move House
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
It's odd how your spouses leave their old place just the same when they move out. This mod changes that. Some spouse rooms will be rarely visited storage rooms. Some will just lack their personal effects. Some may even still have a use by your spouse. I thought about what the remaining people in the house or the spouse (if it's their house) might do with each space and made my changes accordingly. Each room has flavor text, some more than others, depending on the use of the room.

I have used all vanilla tilesheets (or SVE/LUTI ones for their respective patches). This is designed to fit in without standing out.

I became aware of a mod called Spouses Move Out that does the same thing when I entered that name for this mod and Nexus told me it was taken. Ah well. That mod is apparently very outdated, and this is my own spin on it.
[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[spoiler][b]Abigail:[/b]
Pierre takes the space over. Caroline's got her little space in her greenhouse, now Pierre has an office that can be just his. He does work stuff here now instead of on that table in the bedroom while Caroline and Abigail are out and about. It gives him more space to put up family photos he likes too, even ones Abigail doesn't care for.

[b]Alex:[/b]
His room is kept as it was. He took everything he wanted to take, and this is all that's left. Old George and Evelyn don't have a use for the space, and they're too frail to change it much on their own anyway. He'll always have a space in their home, if he wants it.

[b]Elliott:[/b]
His cabin was a dark hole, and having a life outside of that hole does him good. He can visit the beach any time he likes. So he's fixed the place up and put it up for rent. Beachfront rentals can earn a pretty penny, and it lets him share the lovely beach he cares about with others from afar.

[b]Emily:[/b]
You know Haley, she's not particularly keen on cleaning and she has a lot of spare stuff. So what's left of Emily's room goes straight to storage space and gains a few cobwebs.

[b]Haley:[/b]
Haley takes most of her stuff with her, and Emily keeps her space clean and takes care of any plants she left behind. Emily has a few things she stores in here, but mainly she uses it to give more plants some sun at Haley's window.

[b]Harvey:[/b]
This place is pure storage space. It's full of things he just didn't want to take with him in the move and spare dividers and chairs for the office. Maybe one day, if the town needs it, he can use it for more space for patients or something.

[b]Leah:[/b]
Leah worked hard for her little cabin and harder to make it nice, and her marriage schedule does stand outside of it when she goes out. So she keeps it as a sculpting studio. She has a phone there so you'll know if she loses track of time and decides to crash there instead of walking home in the dark. Imagine that some days maybe you take her lunch and eat with her on her little table. It's her space, but of course you're welcome there.

[b]Maru:[/b]
Maru's room is always ready for her to come back. Whatever she left behind, that's staying where it is. It's not that Demetrius thinks you're going to break up, he just finds it hard to think of the space as anyone's but Maru's. Robin uses her now-empty little basement as storage though, which is why it's kept locked up.

[b]Penny:[/b]
Penny's room is kept as is for the most part, trailer or house. No matter how good things are going, Pam knows the value of having a backup place to stay. Pam leaves it alone altogether, as she would if Penny was home. So it's dusty, and the plants have been removed so they don't die.

[b]Sam:[/b]
Sam's room is in a bit of stasis. When he gets older, Vincent's probably going to get a room upgrade when he's older and needs more space, but for now, it's overflow. There's a bit of storage, and Vincent and Jas play there sometimes.

[b]Sebastian:[/b]
Everyone in the house uses it as storage if they need space. It is a dark basement, after all. Not prime real estate. There's lots of reclaimed wood and spare things in here. After you get his terrarium, his game table will return, since it is storage, after all. And his mom probably made it.

[b]Shane:[/b]
Marnie keeps his room as a guest room. She doesn't know who'd show up to be a guest here, but she likes the idea of it anyway. While she has no guests, she can also store some of her stock in there and away from the fireplace. (If you don't have a mod that cleans up the area around her fireplace, basically in vanilla, then Shane moving out will also clean up the area around her fireplace of flammable hay)[/spoiler]
[color=#29292e]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color]

[spoiler][b]Scarlett:[/b]
With Scarlett moved out, Treyvon gets to move his desk out of the bedroom and into a new office space.

[b]Olivia and Victor:[/b]
The Jenkins keep their house. They can afford it, and where else do you expect them to keep all those books? They merely take some personal things with them. Neither needs the space that the other's room would give them, so they stay as guest rooms.

[b]Rasmodius:[/b]
He conjures new furniture. So his house doesn't change. He also visits his home every Thursday to do stuff.

[b]Sophia:[/b]
She's sentimental, and she doesn't really want to completely clear out and repurpose her family's home. So she just took along personal things and her sewing machine.

[b]Lance and Claire:[/b]
You only see where they live in pre-marriage events, so I haven't done anything here.[/spoiler]
[color=#29292e]Ridgeside Village[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44103/44103-1775282114-301386833.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[spoiler][b]Alissa:[/b]
Her parents spent so long without her, that they can't really bring themselves to change her room. She takes some stuff with her, and that's it.

[b]Anton and Kiarra:[/b]
There's always plenty of stuff in need of storage space at Heaps. If either moves out, that's the fate of their room. Perhaps one day they'll need a room for a kid, but until then...

[b]Blair:[/b]
Carmen's like Pam. She knows the value of always having a place you're welcome to come home to. So she keeps Blair's room intact, minus what Blair leaves with.

[b]Corine:[/b]
Ezekiel has a lot of stuff sitting around in boxes, and he moves what he can into the newly vacated space.

[b]Faye:[/b]
Her house becomes a little boutique. She still sells her work here.

[b]Ian and Sean:[/b]
They take their things along. If Ian moves out, things get a bit messier. If Sean moves out, things get much cleaner. If both move out, they move a lot of that clutter from the front into the back as storage space.

[b]Irene:[/b]
She already moved out of her room, so no change here.

[b]Jeric:[/b]
Jeric still keeps his farm and visits often, so storage takes over the vacated space. But he turns his old bedroom into a private home gym.

[b]Kenneth:[/b]
He still visits home every week, so it's a place for tinkering with mechanical stuff now. He's moved living stuff out and moved in more spare parts.

[b]Maddie:[/b]
Maddie's house is cleared out and offered up for rent as a vacation house.

[b]Paula:[/b]
She still uses the clinic, of course. So the new free space is divided up to make a new patient examination room and a small records room she can lock.

[b]Shiro:[/b]
With him moved out, the room is now fully Yuuma's. He can spread out his stuff more.

[b]Zayne:[/b]
His room is barely his as it is. It doesn't change. He just buys new stuff for his spouse room.

[b]Ysabelle, Flor, Philip, June:[/b]
Their rooms at the hotel are vacated for tourists to rent. This is already how things worked for June.

[b]Bryle, Jio, Daia:[/b]
None of these people actually has a bed or living space to begin with.[/spoiler]
